title: K-flat replacements within finite filtered module complexes
statement:
Let $R$ be a commutative ring. A finitely filtered complex means an integer cochain complex $K$ of $R$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] with a decreasing filtration by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration] and integers $a<b$ such that $F^aK=K$ and $F^bK=0$ as complexes. Write $\operatorname{gr}^iK=F^iK/F^{i+1}K$ [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. A filtered quasi-isomorphism is a filtered chain map inducing a quasi-isomorphism on each $\operatorname{gr}^i$. Call such a complex good if all modules $K^n,(F^iK)^n,(\operatorname{gr}^iK)^n$ are flat (tensoring with each preserves exact sequences), and all complexes $K,F^iK,\operatorname{gr}^iK$ are K-flat [def-pc-module-kflat-complex].
Every finitely filtered complex $K$ admits a filtered map $P\to K$ which is a quasi-isomorphism on the underlying complex, on every filtration step, and on every graded complex, where $P$ is good, $F^aP=P$, $F^bP=0$, and every module $P^n,(F^iP)^n,(\operatorname{gr}^iP)^n$ is free [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. There is no bound required on the cochain degrees of $P$.
Let $\mathcal H_f(R)$ be the homotopy category of all finitely filtered complexes, where for filtered chain maps $f,g:K\to L$ between finitely filtered complexes a filtration-preserving chain homotopy is a family $h^n:K^n\to L^{n-1}$ satisfying $f-g=dh+hd$ and $h^n(F^iK^n)\subseteq F^iL^{n-1}$, and let $\mathcal G_f(R)$ be its full subcategory of good complexes. Let $W$ denote the filtered quasi-isomorphisms. The inclusion induces an equivalence of localizations
$$\mathcal G_f(R)[W^{-1}]\ \simeq\ \mathcal H_f(R)[W^{-1}].$$
Here localization means formally inverting the indicated maps. Thus comparisons and their equalities may be represented by roofs of filtered chain maps between good complexes. No choice of a functorial free resolution is asserted.
